name: Sea bass with sizzled ginger, chilli & spring onions
assumptions: Yield estimated from 6 sea bass fillets as primary protein (1 fillet per serving).
Total active time ~20 min based on sequential pan-frying (2 batches), aromatics stir-fry, and minimal prep; excludes passive time.
Soy sauce assumed to contain wheat (standard unless specified gluten-free); hence gluten-free=null.
Soy sauce presence makes Vegan=false despite no animal products in other ingredients.
No dairy, eggs, tree nuts, peanuts, sesame, or shellfish ingredients listed; Fish confirmed via sea bass.
instructions:
step 1
Season 6 sea bass fillets with salt and pepper, then slash the skin 3 times.

step 2
Heat a heavy-based frying pan and add 1 tbsp sunflower oil.

step 3
Once hot, fry the sea bass fillets, skin-side down, for 5 mins or until the skin is very crisp and golden. The fish will be almost cooked through.

step 4
Turn over, cook for another 30 seconds - 1 minute, then transfer to a serving plate and keep warm. You’ll need to fry the sea bass fillets in 2 batches.

step 5
Heat 2 tbsp sunflower oil, then fry the large knob of peeled ginger, cut into matchsticks, 3 thinly sliced garlic cloves and 3 thinly shredded red chillies for about 2 mins until golden.

step 6
Take off the heat and toss in the bunch of shredded spring onions. Splash the fish with 1 tbsp soy sauce and spoon over the contents of the pan.

ingredients.name: Sea Bass Fillets
ingredients.assumptions: 6 medium sea bass fillets, ~150 g each raw edible portion (skin-on); typical white fish values used

ingredients.name: Sunflower Oil
ingredients.assumptions: Total 3 tbsp sunflower oil (1 tbsp for pan + 2 tbsp for aromatics); standard vegetable oil density ~14 g/tbsp

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.assumptions: Large knob of fresh ginger (~30 g peeled weight); typical raw ginger values

ingredients.name: Garlic Clove
ingredients.assumptions: 3 medium garlic cloves thinly sliced, ~9 g total edible weight; standard raw garlic values

ingredients.name: Red Chilli
ingredients.assumptions: 3 large red chillies shredded, ~30 g each including seeds; typical raw red chili values

ingredients.name: Spring Onions
ingredients.assumptions: 1 bunch spring onions shredded, ~100 g trimmed edible weight; standard raw scallion values

ingredients.name: Soy Sauce
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tbsp regular soy sauce (~15 g); typical values for Chinese-style soy sauce
